protocol.name: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant with Bearer Token Use
protocol.description: The reference OAuth 2.0 flow: a pre-registered client obtains an access token through the authorization code grant (with PKCE) and presents it as a bearer token to a resource server.

entities.name: Resource Owner
entities.description: The person who owns the protected data and grants consent

entities.name: Client
entities.description: A pre-registered application acting on the resource owner's behalf

entities.name: Authorization Server
entities.description: Operated by the resource side. Authenticates the user, records consent, issues tokens

entities.name: Resource Server
entities.description: Hosts the protected API and accepts access tokens

phases.name: Client Registration (one time)
phases.description: The client is registered with this authorization server before any flow runs

phases.name: Obtaining Authorization (RFC 6749 section 4.1)
phases.description: The user authenticates and consents at the authorization server

phases.name: Issuing an Access Token (RFC 6749 section 5)
phases.description: The client redeems the authorization code at the token endpoint

phases.name: Accessing Protected Resources (RFC 6749 section 7, RFC 6750)
phases.description: The client presents the access token as a bearer credential

phases.name: Refreshing an Access Token (RFC 6749 section 6)
phases.description: The client obtains a new access token without user involvement

flows.label: Register client_id, redirect_uri, client secret (out of band)

annotations.text: Identity is per authorization server. A client_id means nothing anywhere else.

flows.label: 302 to /authorize with response_type=code, client_id, scope, state, code_challenge
GET /authorize then login and consent screen

annotations.text: Consent is a standing grant of scopes. It carries no statement of why or for which task.

flows.label: 302 to redirect_uri with code and state
POST /token with grant_type=authorization_code, code, code_verifier, client authentication

annotations.text: Bearer means possession is authority. Anyone holding the token can use it unless DPoP or mTLS binding is added.

flows.label: Validate token by JWT verification or introspection
